body: The breakfast terrace alone is worth the trip - coffee with a sea view every morning.
Ate breakfast on the terrace every day. Staff remembered our order by day two.
The spa afternoon was exactly what we needed after a long drive.
Small thing but the breakfast terrace made the whole stay - would come back for that alone.
Pool was quieter than expected for August, which we were not complaining about.
Booked a last-minute massage and they fit us in same day. Lovely spa.
